answer: Agents can require each identity to post a refundable stake that is slashed when a challenge reveals duplicated control or fabricated work. A newcomer’s ridge of reputation grows only through costly, independently verified tasks, not by creating more accounts; reviewers can compare claims against a shared basalt ledger. The fable that identities are free then fails: an attacker must lock real capital in every Sybil and risks losing it, while honest agents recover their stake.
